findings.location: Definition, opening sentence: the assertion that the listed matrix spaces are Lie subalgebras under the commutator.
findings.evidence: The item verifies bracket closure but does not establish that the ambient matrix commutator satisfies Jacobi. Its only declared dependency, def-lie-algebra-over-a-field, defines the Lie-algebra axioms but does not prove this matrix fact. The assigned consumer cites the claim as [F1] and uses it in Proof 3.1 for the even Jacobi component. Add the direct associative expansion of [[A,B],C] + [[B,C],A] + [[C,A],B], whose terms cancel, or depend on a proved local supplier. Knapp §I.1, Example 2, printed p. 25, supplies that expansion.

findings.location: Frontmatter sources.references, Knapp entry, locator field.
findings.evidence: The locator says the §1 examples are on printed pp. 42–48, but the linked digital second edition places the general matrix-commutator Jacobi expansion at §I.1, Example 2, printed p. 25, and matrix subalgebra closure examples at Examples 7–9, printed pp. 26–27 (Knapp, Lie Groups Beyond an Introduction). Correct the locator to those sections and pages. This is a nonfatal citation defect; the item's separate Etingof reference is also relevant.

coverage_note: Reviewed both assigned pages, all 23 assigned items, direct dependencies needed for their claims, and both declared page requirements. I did not audit unrelated transitive dependency branches or every item on the prerequisite pages; the assigned proofs do not import those unrelated claims.
